tentacles.name: ca
tentacles.blurb: Plan local TLS files under ~/.kraken/data/ca. Not a public CA. Not in core.
tentacles.docs: Plans local TLS files under ~/.kraken/data/ca. Not a public CA. Not in core.

tentacles.name: countries
tentacles.blurb: REST Countries v3. No key.
tentacles.docs: REST Countries v3. No key.

tentacles.name: docker-env
tentacles.blurb: Build a Docker Compose environment from a service list, start it when Docker exists, and emit a share spec so another Kraken box can join the same services.
tentacles.docs: Compose plan. Bind 127.0.0.1 unless public:true.

tentacles.name: expose
tentacles.blurb: Plan a *.kraken.localhost name on 127.0.0.1. Never binds 0.0.0.0.
tentacles.docs: Plans *.kraken.localhost on 127.0.0.1. Default deny until kraken grant expose.
tentacles.example: kraken grant expose && kraken run expose plan --payload '{"host":"panel.kraken.localhost"}'

tentacles.name: filesort
tentacles.blurb: Walk a path, hash files, detect duplicates, tag by extension. SQLite index under .kraken/data/filesort.
tentacles.docs: Walk a path, hash files, detect duplicates.

tentacles.name: geo
tentacles.blurb: Offline IP/zip fixture. 1.1.1.1 → Los Angeles. First JSON after kraken demo.
tentacles.docs: Local CLI plugin runner fixture. No network. kraken demo runs this lookup so install prints JSON in under 60s.

tentacles.name: hotreload
tentacles.blurb: Development hot-refresh. Register roots and a command; tick hashes files and reruns when they change.
tentacles.docs: Development hot-refresh. Register roots and a command; tick hashes files and reruns when they change.

tentacles.name: ipwhere
tentacles.blurb: ip-api.com JSON, no key. Fixture when offline.
tentacles.docs: ip-api.com JSON, no key. Fixture when offline.

tentacles.name: llm
tentacles.blurb: Plan a local LLM container on kraken_llm with read-only ingest mounts.
tentacles.docs: Plan a local model call. Grant llm first. Core ships no weights.
tentacles.example: kraken grant llm && kraken run llm plan

tentacles.name: notes
tentacles.blurb: Encrypted-at-rest notes under ~/.kraken/data/notes
tentacles.docs: Local markdown notes under ~/.kraken/data/notes.

tentacles.name: openmeteo
tentacles.blurb: Open-Meteo forecast. No API key. Offline fixture if the net is down.
tentacles.docs: Open-Meteo forecast. No API key. Offline fixture if the net is down.

tentacles.name: panel
tentacles.blurb: Local Capacitor-friendly panel — settings, paths, resources, contact plan
tentacles.docs: Same-device settings UI. Capacitor loads bundled HTML. Live JSON optional from 127.0.0.1:18181.

tentacles.name: pi-net
tentacles.blurb: Find a Raspberry Pi on the LAN (hosts list or mDNS names) or use raw SSH credentials. No Docker.
tentacles.docs: Find a Raspberry Pi on the LAN (hosts list or mDNS names) or use raw SSH credentials. No Docker.

tentacles.name: quakes
tentacles.blurb: USGS significant earthquakes GeoJSON. No key.
tentacles.docs: USGS significant earthquakes GeoJSON. No key.

tentacles.name: runtime
tentacles.blurb: Run a tentacle request in a user image. Dockerfile + services.yaml only. Shared store/vault/ssh mounts. Dry-run when Docker is missing.
tentacles.docs: Run a tentacle request in a user image. Dockerfile + services.yaml only. Shared store/vault/ssh mounts. Dry-run when Docker is missing.

tentacles.name: scourge
tentacles.blurb: Premium multi-device fleet view. Requires local license key.
tentacles.docs: Premium org fleet. Requires license + kraken grant scourge. Private repo toptacos/kraken-scourge.
tentacles.example: kraken license set scourge KEY && kraken grant scourge && kraken run scourge status

tentacles.name: sites
tentacles.blurb: Multi-site local dev from project .kraken/config.yaml. Compose on kraken_sites, ports on 127.0.0.1. Docker only for up.
tentacles.docs: Multi-site local dev from project .kraken/config.yaml. Compose on kraken_sites, ports on 127.0.0.1. Docker only for up.

tentacles.name: store
tentacles.blurb: Content-addressed result store. Local, S3-mirror, or an encrypted pack another Kraken install can import.
tentacles.docs: Content-addressed result store. Local, S3-mirror, or an encrypted pack another Kraken install can import.

tentacles.name: tunnel
tentacles.blurb: Plan an SSH jump to a host you already have a key for. Does not invent access.
tentacles.docs: Plan only. Grant tunnel first. Does not open a public hole by default.
tentacles.example: kraken grant tunnel && kraken run tunnel plan

tentacles.name: vault
tentacles.blurb: Encrypt credentials and files with AES-256-CBC (openssl, PBKDF2). Bundles move to another Kraken install.
tentacles.docs: Local encrypted store. Keys stay on the box.

tentacles.name: voice-free
tentacles.blurb: Nyx scratch TTS via free local or public APIs. No ElevenLabs.
tentacles.docs: Nyx scratch TTS via free local or public APIs. No ElevenLabs.

tentacles.name: weather-pro
tentacles.blurb: Premium example. Needs geo installed and a license key.
tentacles.docs: Premium forecast arm. Key gated. Private under toptacos/kraken-premium.
tentacles.example: kraken license set weather-pro KEY && kraken run weather-pro forecast

tentacles.name: zippopotam
tentacles.blurb: Zippopotam.us ZIP → city. No key.
tentacles.docs: Zippopotam.us ZIP → city. No key.

tentacles.name: wx
tentacles.blurb: Fetch Open-Meteo, let a sucker convert units, then finish the report.
tentacles.docs: Fetch Open-Meteo (no key). After a sucker patches units, finish writes the report.
tentacles.example:
kraken tentacle add examples/tentacles/wx-units
kraken tentacle add examples/tentacles/wx
kraken run wx forecast --payload '{"lat":36.85,"lon":-76.29}'

tentacles.name: wx-units
tentacles.blurb: Sucker. Convert Open-Meteo Celsius to Fahrenheit and write a summary patch.
tentacles.docs: Does not fetch. Returns patch.temperature_f for wx finish.

tentacles.name: browse-js
tentacles.blurb: osascript + Chrome JS on macOS, Node fixture elsewhere. Envelope kind=text then finish kind=file.
tentacles.docs: Any language. Shell dispatcher. Sucker save-text patches text to file. finish writes the path.
tentacles.example:
k tentacle add examples/tentacles/save-text
k tentacle add examples/tentacles/browse-js
k run browse-js fetch --payload '{"url":"https://example.com"}'

tentacles.name: save-text
tentacles.blurb: JS sucker. Turn a text envelope into a file envelope patch.
tentacles.docs: Does not fetch. Returns patch.kind=file for browse-js finish.

suckers.name: after-echo
suckers.blurb: Named hook. Fires after echo. Does not re-enter.
suckers.docs: Suckers are named hook rows. They point at a tentacle. Hook invokes do not fire hooks.

suckers.name: wx-units
suckers.blurb: Patch wx forecast units. Does not re-enter.
suckers.docs: After wx forecast, convert C to F and return patch. Kraken then calls wx finish.

suckers.name: save-text
suckers.blurb: Patch browse-js text into a file envelope.
suckers.docs: After browse-js fetch, convert kind=text to kind=file. Kraken then calls browse-js finish.
